title: Demonic Path Interference
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone waited for Chen Ji's answer, he suddenly smiled—that smile was cold and mocking, as if watching a group of clowns performing a拙劣 act.

text.content: The pitch-black crack tore open the sky like a blade, demonic energy pouring from the Void like a tide. The bitter cold wind carried scents of decay and blood, instantly shattering the stalemate of the three-way confrontation. Deep within that crack, a giant eye burning with eerie green flames slowly opened, gazing down indifferently at the ants beneath its feet.

dialogue.content: "Interesting, truly most interesting." The voice didn't come from the crack, but exploded directly in everyone's Mental Sea, like ten thousand ghosts wailing, or the heavens murmuring, "The geniuses of three major sects are fighting each other red-faced over a mere废物 servant. This show, this one has waited three thousand years for."

text.content: The representatives of the three factions simultaneously changed their expressions. From Xuanwu Sect's direction, Han Lie's spiritual energy surged wildly, his fists grinding together, yet he dared not act rashly under the will projection's pressure. On Tianqing Sect's side, Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, his withered fingers trembling slightly in his sleeves, whether calculating or fearing was unclear. From the Holy Sect's direction, a graceful figure emerged from the black mist—it was Ye Qing, her gaze lingering on Chen Ji for a moment, a trace of indescribable complexity flickering in her eyes.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." The giant eye slowly turned toward him, the green flames burning more intensely, "Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple, renowned throughout the world as a废物. However—" The voice suddenly turned icy cold, "Do you know the origin of that torn page on your body? Do you know why three major sects have their eyes on you? Do you know... why Heaven's Eye would gaze upon a mere ant like you?"

text.content: Chen Ji stood motionless, allowing that pressure to crush down like a mountain. His expression was平静得近乎麻木, as if truly just a废物 who had been scared silly. Yet if someone could see through his Mental Sea, they would discover—within those lowered eyes, countless information streams were racing like lightning. He was calculating. Calculating each faction's hidden cards, calculating the value of his own筹码, calculating where he stood in this game of chess.

dialogue.content: "Since the senior knows this junior is a废物," Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice neither humble nor overbearing, even carrying a hint of indolence, "then surely the senior also knows废物 have little use. Rather than interrogate this junior here, why not directly ask the old foxes of the three major sects what they're truly after."

text.content: The moment these words fell, all three factions' expressions changed simultaneously. Ling Yuan laughed dryly: "Chen Ji, don't speak nonsense. This old man knows nothing of the Tianji Record, this time I came merely..." Before he could finish, a snicker came from the Holy Sect's direction. Ye Qing stepped forward, her black dress fluttering in the demonic energy: "Why the pretense, Sect Master Ling? The successor of the Tianji Record was indeed taken by your sect's ancestors. This debt, the Holy Sect has always remembered."

dialogue.content: "Enough." The voice of Heaven's Eye suddenly turned cold and stern, like heaven's judgment descending, "This one did not come today to listen to you pass the buck." The giant eye turned to Chen Ji again, the flames burning more intensely, "Chen Ji, this one gives you a chance. Submit to the Demonic Path, and this one shall grant you the complete true Tianji Record, allowing you to glimpse the ultimate secrets of heaven's workings. If you refuse—"

text.content: Before the words finished, from Xuanwu Sect's direction, Han Lie could no longer hold back. He stepped forward, his golden battle armor gleaming brilliantly under the sunlight, his aura surging like a flood: "Demonic monsters, dare not covet our human genius! Chen Ji, Xuanwu Sect is your destination! This one wishes to invite you into the sect with the name of brother, to create great achievements together!" Ling Yuan coldly laughed: "Is Nephew Han trying to snatch someone from our Tianqing Sect?" Han Lie disdainfully replied: "Tianqing Sect? A bunch of hypocrites, no better than the Demonic Path."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji watched this farce before him and suddenly found it somewhat amusing. The three factions exchanged heated words, each flying the banner of "for your own good," each speaking with absolute conviction of being the righteous path. Yet their eyes couldn't deceive—that was the greed of a hunter eyeing prey, the arrogance of seeing others as mere chess pieces. He silently noted in his heart: Xuanwu Sect's hidden card is power suppression and orthodox legitimacy; Tianqing Sect's hidden card is orthodox inheritance and geographical advantage; the Demonic Path's hidden card... is that complete Tianji Record?

text.content: However, just then, deep within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, that long-sealed torn page suddenly grew warm. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice echoed faintly: "Be careful... that is not the true complete Tianji Record. It's merely bait. But this item does share the same source as the Tianji Record; if you can借此 glimpse a trace of the Tianji Record's true appearance..." The words ended as he fell silent again, clearly lacking strength.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly spoke, her voice cold as frost: "Chen Ji, don't listen to their nonsense." She stepped forward, demonic energy forming an圈 of mysterious mist around her, "The Holy Sect's condition is simple—become our ally, not a chess piece. Resource sharing, intelligence exchange. The person you seek..." Her gaze flickered slightly, "We are also seeking."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened abruptly. The person being sought—Chen Nian. His younger sister, his closest kin taken by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." How could Ye Qing know he was searching for Chen Nian? Unless... the Holy Sect already knew Chen Nian's whereabouts, and Ye Qing's true purpose this time was to use this as leverage to coerce him.

text.content: The three factions reacted differently—Han Lie flew into a rage, Ling Yuan coldly said nothing, yet Ye Qing's eyes flickered with a profound light. Only Chen Ji himself knew that in that instant, he had taken in everyone's reactions.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slightly turned his body, seemingly casually meeting Ye Qing's gaze. To onlookers, it appeared to be a waste servant coveting the saint's beauty, but in the next instant, a flash of understanding crossed Ye Qing's eyes—she had received a covert mental transmission.

text.content: "Excellent." Ye Qing's voice resonated in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. "In three days, at the bottom of the Soul Severing Cliff, you and I shall meet again. At that time, I will tell you everything." Her lips curved slightly upward, and demonic path mist quietly spread around Chen Ji, concealing the aura of the fragment for him.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That laughter gradually shifted from low and suppressed to full-bodied, carrying an indescribable madness and exhilaration. The three factions looked at each other in bewilderment, unsure what medicine this waste had in his葫芦.

"Enough!" Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, and those eyes that had always been lowered finally burst forth with sharp brilliance. "I, Chen Ji, am neither an inheritor of the Tianji Record nor a废物. I am merely... an旁观者 who has seen through your tricks."

text.content: Just as the various factions were惊疑不定 due to his reaction, Chen Ji's spiritual sense cut like a blade into the Heavenly Eye's vast意志 projection. He saw—in the depths behind that eerie green flame, countless dense因果 threads, each connecting to a "预言者." Some threads had already withered and snapped, while others trembled slightly. He saw himself, saw the thin silver thread above his head—it was being gently plucked by an invisible hand.

dialogue.content: "Oh?" A note of amusement appeared in the Heavenly Eye's voice. "What do you see?" It seemed unconcerned about how many secrets Chen Ji had glimpsed, instead treating it like anticipating this little game. "Three thousand years, and finally another ant who can see因果 threads. Interesting, interesting... This One has decided not to kill you."

text.content: The voice suddenly turned bone-chillingly cold: "Because This One shall let you witness firsthand—how everything you have gone to great lengths to protect gets destroyed one by one." Chen Ji felt an icy chill rise from the soles of his feet straight to his spiritual crown. Yet at the same time, the rage suppressed deep within his heart was quietly burning. He memorized it. He silently记下了 in his heart. Every single account, he would collect with interest.

Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings—the Heavenly Eye's意志 projection悬空, the three factions with swords drawn and bows bent, and himself standing at the very center of this storm. Everyone was awaiting his answer, waiting for him to become the pawn to be used. However this time, he did not intend to follow anyone's script.

Just as the tension reached its peak, the虚空 above Soul Severing Cliff suddenly rippled. A sharp sword intent passed like a startled swan, followed by a cold female voice: "Chen Ji, you are indeed here." Su Qingyao rode her sword, her white garments纯白like snow, her face frost-cold. Her gaze swept across the three factions before finally fixing on Chen Ji, her eyes flickering with complex, unfathomable emotions.

dialogue.content: "Inner Sect Senior Fellow?" Ling Yuan frowned. "Su Shixia, what brings you here?" Su Qingyao淡淡道: "This disciple received orders from master to bring Chen Ji back to the sect." Her words made all three factions change color—was Tianqing Sect trying to强行保人? However, Su Qingyao's next words left everyone stunned: "But before that, Chen Ji, I have something to ask you."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Su Qingyao, that ice-cold face filled with审视 and探究. This was the fourth time. He sighed slightly in his heart—the Inner Sect Senior Fellow's suspicion of him had never ceased. Yet with three factions eyeing him covetously, why did she choose to appear at this moment... coincidence, or ulterior motive? Just then, Su Qingyao suddenly tilted her head slightly,低声: "Don't do as they say." The voice was so low only Chen Ji could hear.

Chen Ji's heart猛地一颤. What did Su Qingyao know? Why would she risk offending all factions to warn him under the watchful eyes of everyone? He recalled how over these three years, this Inner Sect Senior Fellow had countless times "coincidentally" appeared near him, countless times using investigation as an excuse to actually protect him. His intuition told him Su Qingyao was not the enemy. But was her trust worth the risk of exposing his底牌?

The three factions seemed to have reached some默契, pressing down on Chen Ji in unison. The Heavenly Eye's massive eye slowly rotated, its eerie green flames flickering increasingly strangely; Han Lie's浑身 battle intent surged, his golden war armor humming; Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, his withered fingers slightly掐诀 inside his sleeve; Ye Qing's lips carried a meaningful smile,似乎在等待什么. Only Su Qingyao stood quietly at Chen Ji's side, her fingers gripping the sword hilt slightly white.

At this moment, Chen Ji suddenly saw everything clearly. The Heavenly Eye wanted a obedient chess piece, a tool to weave因果 and harvest天命气运. The three major sects wanted the Tianji Record inheritance, that heaven-defying ability to foresee the future. What Ye Qing wanted was perhaps Chen Nian, that "天命锁钥" who could resonate with the Tianji Record. And Su Qingyao... what she wanted was perhaps only the truth.

dialogue.content: "Fellows seniors, brothers and sisters," Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice平静得没有一丝波澜, "what you want, I can give you. But not now, not under such coercion." He surveyed his surroundings, his gaze finally fixing on that悬空的 massive eye. "In three days, at the bottom of Soul Severing Cliff, I will give you all a satisfactory answer. Before that—" He suddenly wore a意味深长的 smile, "please everyone return home, eat well, drink well, and rest up. After all, the show ahead will be far more精彩 than now."

text.content: After the words fell, Soul Severing Cliff fell into死一般的寂静. The representatives of the three factions looked at each other, unsure what this废物 was up to. The Heavenly Eye's massive eye slightly narrowed, its green flames flickering uncertainly,似乎在思考这只蝼蚁葫芦里卖的什么药. Han Lie冷哼一声: "You think you have the qualifications to negotiate with us?" Yet Ling Yuan raised his hand to stop him, his withered face浮现出一丝玩味的笑容: "Interesting... This old one would like to see what tricks you can pull."

Chen Ji paid no attention to their reactions, only turning to Su Qingyao with a slight nod: "Senior Sister Su, thank you for the reminder." His voice was soft, yet carried a trace of sincerity. Su Qingyao coldly gazed at him, then淡淡道 after a moment: "Don't let me down." With that, she rode her sword upward, her white robes fluttering, soon disappearing into the clouds. Ye Qing gave Chen Ji a meaningful深意 glance, her身形 dissolving into black mist. Only the Heavenly Eye's massive eye remained for a moment, a flicker of... playfulness seemingly passing through those green flames.

When the last wisp of demonic energy dissipated in the wind, only Chen Ji remained atop the Deadly Cliff. He stood motionless in place, allowing the mountain wind to brush past his robes. After a long while, he suddenly smiled. That smile was cold and mocking, as if watching a group of buffoons giving a拙劣 shoddy performance. Three days' time... was enough. Enough for him to set his pieces, enough for him to break the game, and more than enough to let everyone know—Chen Ji had never been a pawn to be manipulated.

In the depths of his Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a melancholic sigh: "You've finally seen the truth." Chen Ji responded in his heart: "What does seeing it matter? This game was unfair from the start. The Eye of Heavenly Dao, the Three Great Sects, and those hidden watchers... they are all chess players, while I'm merely a piece on their board." Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before replying: "But have you ever considered—why did the Tianji Record choose you? Why were all the previous prophets manipulated by it, yet you alone can break free from its control?" Chen Ji was stunned. Mo Xiansheng's voice became ethereal: "Because you don't believe in destiny. And this... might be the key to breaking the game."
